meta.opis: RelAI keeps your project's memory in plain files beside your code, so every session with an AI agent starts where the last one stopped. Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

hero.zdanie: Plain files beside your code hold what your AI agent forgets. Each new session starts where the last one stopped.

przystanki.tekst: You explain the project again, hunt for yesterday's decision and fix the same mistake a second time.
State, journal, lessons and decisions are plain Markdown files beside your code. A session reads them at the start and adds to them as you work.
Big work goes in stages. Once accepted, the plan is frozen and every stage starts in a fresh session.

przystanki.naglowek: It all shows above the prompt.
przystanki.tekst: Bars in the Claude Code window show the plan, the stage's progress, your limits and the session's cost.
“Let's continue”, “wrapping up”: RelAI understands phrases and has commands for a stage, a side thread, a backup and a review.

instalacja.tekst: Pick your tool and parts. Copy the commands, or open them in the terminal and send them yourself with Enter.
